_note: Built-in starter shot-contract templates. Venture templates on disk (<Content>/<venture>/shot_contract_templates/<slug>.json) override a built-in with the same slug.

templates.name: Product spin
templates.summary: A slow quarter turn of a product on a clean tabletop, camera locked off, no hands.

shot_contract.primary_action: the product rotates slowly while staying centered in frame
shot_contract.source_frame_read: the source frame already shows the product centered on a clean tabletop with no hands visible

role_blocking.gaze: absent because there is no human subject
role_blocking.body_orientation: absent because the subject is a product

shot_contract.motion_budget: the product stays within the central third of frame with only a small rotation

time_segments.camera: Locked-off tripod, fixed frame, fixed lens. Camera does not move at all.
time_segments.action: the product performs a slow quarter turn without changing shape
time_segments.forbidden_zone: edges of frame remain empty and no extra objects enter

shot_contract.lighting_lock: constant softbox light from camera-left with no exposure changes

templates.name: Cooking scene, hands committed
templates.summary: HR voice-command ad scenes where the woman is cooking and her hands MUST remain on the cutting board for the duration. Closes the failure mode where Veo/Kling/Seedance hallucinated 'reaching for laptop' or 'typing on keyboard' motions. Use as baseline shot_contract for any HR cooking-scene shot; override time_segments and any campaign-specific fields inline.

shot_contract.primary_action: the woman keeps both herb-stained hands committed to chopping herbs on a wooden cutting board for the full clip
shot_contract.source_frame_read: the source frame already shows the woman from a back-of-shoulder or three-quarter angle with her left hand pinning herbs on the cutting board and her right hand mid-grip on a chef knife; her gaze is fixed down on the board; any device visible in frame is already in its passive state — phone face-down on counter or laptop closed/blurred — and not in contact with her hands

role_blocking.hands_left: pins herbs on the cutting board with curled fingertips, never leaves the board
role_blocking.hands_right: performs small repeated vertical chopping motions with a chef knife on the cutting board
role_blocking.gaze: fixed down on the cutting board
role_blocking.body_orientation: three-quarter facing camera, slight forward lean over the counter

allowed_contact_surfaces: chopped herbs and vegetables on the board

tracked_objects.name: knife
tracked_objects.allowed_state_change: small vertical chopping motion held by right hand throughout
tracked_objects.forbidden_state_change: morphing, multiplying, teleporting between hands, blade transforming, knife leaving hand

tracked_objects.name: tomatoes and herbs on cutting board
tracked_objects.allowed_state_change: progressive chopping — accumulating chopped pieces, slight repositioning by left hand
tracked_objects.forbidden_state_change: morphing, count change beyond progressive chopping, color drift, teleporting onto other surfaces

tracked_objects.name: device in scene (laptop or phone)
tracked_objects.allowed_state_change: none — remains in exact starting position and state throughout
tracked_objects.forbidden_state_change: moving, rotating, screen-content change, opening/closing, lighting change on screen, any contact with hands or food

shot_contract.motion_budget: both hands stay within the cutting-board rectangle for the full clip duration, no reach gestures, no object transfer outside the board, no contact with any other surface in frame

time_segments.camera: Locked-off tripod, fixed frame, fixed lens. Camera does not move at all.
time_segments.action: right hand performs 3-4 small vertical chopping motions with the knife, left hand holds herbs in place
time_segments.forbidden_zone: device area in frame remains static and untouched; no fingers, herbs, knife, sleeve, or shadow enters the device area

shot_contract.camera_lock: Locked-off tripod, fixed frame, fixed lens. Camera does not move at all: no pan, tilt, zoom, dolly, roll, rack focus, handheld sway, or reframing. Background remains fixed.
shot_contract.lighting_lock: constant exposure throughout, no time-of-day drift, no relight, soft north-window light from camera-right held steady; warm kitchen ambient unchanged across all segments

audio_lock.description: ambient kitchen room tone only — no dialogue, no music, no foley except natural knife-on-board if model produces it. External VO and SFX are mixed in post (audio mixer pipeline).

shot_contract.end_state: right hand mid-chop with knife on board; left hand still pinning herbs; cutting board has visibly more chopped material than at frame 0; device unchanged
